def state(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,pat in [('R','R'),('b','b'),('N','N')]:

        out[name]=(min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    m=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    out['M']=(min(r for r,c in m),max(r for r,c in m),min(c for r,c in m),max(c for r,c in m))
    return out
print('start:',state(current_frame))
